name: mga
description: MGA — Multi-tenant web analytics (Collect → Queue → MSSQL API)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mga/shared && npm run build -w @mga/sdk && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @mga/shared && npm run build -w @mga/sdk
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n shared,collector,writer,mock,query,dash -c gray,blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @mga/shared" "tsx watch services/collector/src/index.ts" "tsx watch services/writer/src/index.ts" "tsx watch services/mock-mssql-api/src/index.ts" "tsx watch services/query-api/src/index.ts" "node apps/dashboard/server.mjs"
